letter.subject: My Dearest Layla,
letter.body:
From the very first moment I saw you, something inside me knew — you were different. You were the one.

Every day with you is a reminder of how lucky I am. Your smile is my safe place. Your voice is the melody I never want to stop hearing. And your heart — your heart is the most beautiful thing I have ever known.

You make me want to be better, to dream bigger, to love deeper. With you, even the simplest moments become the ones I hold onto forever.

Thank you for choosing me. Thank you for being you. Thank you for being mine.

With all my love,
Ibrahim 💜

timeline.description: April 9th, 2026 — the day my life changed forever. I remember every detail of the moment I first met you in Mansoura.

timeline.title: Our First Coffee at Coffee Bear
timeline.description: We sat across from each other and the hours disappeared. That little café in Mansoura became one of my favorite places on earth.

timeline.title: Graduation Day
timeline.description: May 5th — a day of pride and joy. Watching you graduate was one of the most beautiful moments I've ever witnessed.

timeline.title: Walks in Mansoura
timeline.description: Wandering through the streets of our city together — every corner holds a memory of us.

timeline.title: Right Now
timeline.description: And here we are — and I wouldn't trade a single moment for anything in the world.
